successCriteria.note: c7-sidebar-and-board.png: In progress, Backlog, Kanban, Completed; Kanban opens the four-lane board.
c2 and c5: a board/desktop-created card and a planner MCP-created card both in Backlog with DM keys, in repo mode (records in c4) and in db mode (nothing in the repo).
c6: Play opened the agent and model chooser and started an orchestrator chat that claimed DM-5, committed on the checked-out branch and submitted; no person moved the card.
c6 and c8: evidence reviewed, kick-back comment delivered to the agent and the card back In progress, then approved to Done; c5 and c3 show approve and kick back refused for agents.
c8: compact Done rows, collapsed and paged lane, and getKanbanCard only when a card is opened; full attempts and evidence kept.
c9 and the delivery-standards copies: the routing sentence is in the served prompts and the standards.
The full suite (9243 tests), coverage, deadcode, lint, typecheck and build pass; Fireguard A (90), no F.

outcome.summary: Kanban shipped in one sprint: a per-folder board of isolated cards that a person or an agent adds, a person plays, an orchestrator agent carries to Ready for review, and a person approves or kicks back. It works in repo and db storage modes. Every success criterion was verified in the built app or by command output, including a real Claude Code run.

title: Kanban: a per-folder board of isolated tickets that agents carry to review and a person approves
